synthetic_arithmetic_control.scope: synthetic arithmetic control; not an operator witness

claim_scope.exact_check_qualification: Fraction arithmetic is authoritative for each selected binary32 entry, but selecting finitely many entries cannot prove the global envelopes
claim_scope.operator_qualification: only the small 2x2 stalling witness invokes the actual slow P9 operator; the envelope cases isolate outer-shell arithmetic
claim_scope.stalling_qualification: raw subtraction stalling is an exact executable P9 finite witness; compensated progress here is not a convergence theorem
claim_scope.status: sampled CPU falsification diagnostic plus one exact finite stalling witness; not a global certificate

bound_operator.domain: finite matrices of each locked shape

config.entrywise_roundoff_model: |fl32(x)-x|<=2^-24*|x|+2^-150; RNE, gradual underflow, finite named intermediates, no fusion or reassociation
